push.title: L 1-5 vs pilot grape | You: 6.1 (3rd worst match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.1. One bad night doesn't make a bad player. It makes a story you'll tell later.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ Giveaways 3, down from your usual 6. You can build a whole match on that.
+ Missed tackles 0, from 5 in your previous match. That's the version of you I'm building the team around.

THE BAD
- No tackles attempted. Here's a thought: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- 70% passing (7 of 10). Remember this: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.
- Rating came in 0.7 below what your on-ball stats earned. Little adjustment: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks. That's a coach's honest word.
- Shots 0, down from your usual 2. Here's what helps: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback.
- We shipped 5 goals to pilot grape and lost by 4. We win together and we wear this together.

Training ground: Make yourself big in the box when they shoot. Blocks count, even if the stats don't.

BellyTb1, from me to you: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

Trust the work. - Coach Lasso
